header.note: What the lab adds to the strings of the provider in development (config/packages/lab.yaml), and no image carries: one message per type of authorization detail the lab wires (RFC 9396 §2), named after that type, because the type is a class of the deployment and the sentence a user reads before agreeing to one belongs with it. ICU message format; the parameters of a detail are the ones its type put in the rendering of it.
